prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1209; do not mention it.)
text: On arrival at the intersection, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a sedan and an SUV. The sedan, identified as Driver 1, was stopped partially within the eastbound lane. The SUV, operated by Driver 2, showed heavy front-end damage on the driver's side and was positioned against the curb. A single passenger was seated in the front of the SUV and was assisted out of the vehicle by responding personnel. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and stated the impact occurred on the passenger side of the sedan when Driver 2 entered the intersection. Driver 2 stated that the traffic signal had turned yellow before entering. Both vehicles were driveable prior to towing. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Visible skid marks were noted leading from the SUV's path. Driver 1 declined transport by ambulance at the scene but was advised to seek medical evaluation. Photographs were taken and statements were recorded from all parties. Traffic was diverted around the scene until both vehicles were removed.
